message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
# 1x1 RGBA, but with malformed eXIf before IDAT and after IDAT
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
exif_bad=chunk(b'eXIf', b'Exif\x00\x00' + b'A'*2)
raw=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
# try multiple placements
cases={
 'exif_before.png': sig+ihdr+exif_bad+idat+iend,
 'exif_after_idat.png': sig+ihdr+idat+exif_bad+iend,
 'exif_after_iend.png': sig+ihdr+idat+iend+exif_bad,
}
for n,d in cases.items(): pathlib.Path(n).write_bytes(d); print(n,len(d))
PY
for f in /workspace/exif_before.png /workspace/exif_after_idat.png /workspace/exif_after_iend.png; do echo "== $f =="; bash /workspace/submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true; done
